author: Pubity
text:
A group of Italian professional water polo players are at risk of being arrested in Japan for walking through downtown Tokyo in their speedos.

Angry locals have reported them to the police and are demanding the muscular Italians be arrested for public indecency.

slides_data.text:
Following a wave of youth violence in early 2024, Attal was heavily criticized by left-wing politicians and civil rights groups for adopting hard-right messaging.

He claimed French teenagers were "addicted to violence," called for a "surge of authority" and controversially proposed that certain minors under 18 be tried as adults in the legal system.
